editable-scene.summary: Plays immediately with its bundled solid shader.
editable-scene.cues: Use the replay companion in a separate owned renderer to demonstrate editing and export.
editable-scene.requirements: Wrapped replay needs VisualsQuark replay API 1.

sieve.summary: Masks the bundled photograph with a tiled image.
sieve.cues: The SuperCollider companion configures a separate renderer through ordinary OSC replay.
sieve.requirements: Keep the bundled JPEG and mask with the scene.

organic-trails.summary: Animated particle trails accumulate through shader feedback.
organic-trails.cues: The authoring guide describes live edits and controls.

sound-data.summary: The bundled shader displays a baseline color before receiving analysis values.
sound-data.cues: SuperCollider audio analysis drives color and intensity.
sound-data.requirements: Live response needs a SuperCollider audio server and a microphone or local audio file.

intro.summary: A grid opens with a shader texture in its first layer.
intro.cues: Cues demonstrate layouts, images, sketches, layer controls and a synthetic amplitude sample.

shaders.summary: The bundled RotStringsV shader runs as a texture.
shaders.cues: Cues demonstrate sine and input-controlled glow and color, unload and grid reload.

sketches.summary: Spiral runs as a built-in sketch texture.

performance.summary: Three layers open with sketch and shader sources ready for transitions.
performance.cues: Run the companion cues for two ten-second fades.

test.summary: Shows an image, shader texture, sketch and solid color in a grid.
test.cues: Cues exercise transforms, reset and unload.

camera.summary: Displays a lit penguin model through the scene camera.
camera.cues: Cues demonstrate camera moves, orbit and FXAA.
camera.requirements: Uses OpenGL 4.1 and the bundled model and texture.

geom.summary: Displays boxes textured with the bundled photograph.
geom.requirements: Uses OpenGL 4.1 and the bundled model assets for the cue.

buffer.summary: Draws 4,356 instanced boxes driven by shader buffers.
buffer.cues: The companion provides a setup with expressions and camera clipping.
buffer.requirements: Requires OpenGL 4.1, GPU instancing and buffer support.

deferred.summary: Lights a box through the deferred pipeline.
deferred.cues: The companion setup demonstrates the original randomized red channel.
deferred.requirements: Requires OpenGL 4.1, deferred shading and its staged shaders.

clouds.summary: Ray marches a cloud volume using tiled noise.
clouds.cues: The companion supplies its own blank-renderer setup.
clouds.requirements: Uses OpenGL 4.1, the bundled noise image and shader includes.

grass.summary: Runs a procedural ground grid and a geometry-stage grass shader.
grass.cues: The companion supplies its own blank-renderer setup.
grass.requirements: Requires OpenGL 4.1 and geometry shader support.

particles-gpu.summary: Animates 16,384 instanced particles with a shared ping-pong source.
particles-gpu.cues: The companion supplies its own blank-renderer setup.
particles-gpu.requirements: Requires OpenGL 4.1, instancing, buffers and a floating-point render target.

video.cues: Cues seek, trigger playback and switch to double speed.
video.requirements: Choose a readable MOV or MP4 with a codec the renderer supports.

webcam-delay.summary: Shows live camera output and delayed camera samples.
webcam-delay.cues: The companion has a separate history cue for blank-renderer setup.
webcam-delay.requirements: Requires a connected camera and Camera permission for VOSC.

webcam-looper.summary: Shows the selected live camera feed.
webcam-looper.cues: Cues record and repeat a two-second loop and return to live video.
webcam-looper.requirements: Requires a connected camera and Camera permission for VOSC.

ultralight.summary: Renders the NASA Astronomy Picture of the Day page as an HTML texture.
ultralight.cues: The companion supplies its own blank-renderer setup.
ultralight.requirements: Requires USE_OFX_ULTRALIGHT, matching runtime libraries and a reachable page.
